\label{claim1II.4.2}
Given $(x_0,t_0)\in\M$, set $Q=|R(x_0,t_0)|+r(t_0)^{-2}$. Then
\[
R(x,t)\leq8Q\quad\text{for }(x,t)\in
P\left(x_0,t_0,\tfrac12\eta^{-1}Q^{-1/2},-\tfrac18\eta^{-1}Q^{-1}\right),
\]
where $\eta$ is from (\ref{II.(1.3)estimates}).
\end{lemma}
